name: The Day I Died
source:
He calls it an interview. You call it a nightmare.

Talk sweetly, move quietly, and maybe you’ll leave this room alive.

[From [url=https://digitalshortcake.itch.io/the-day-i-died]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他称之为采访。你称之为噩梦。

甜言蜜语，安静地行动，也许你就能活着离开这个房间。

[来自[url=https://digitalshortcake.itch.io/the-day-i-died]Itch.io[/url]]
